aerospace.title: Aerospace and Deep-Space Exploration Are Core Neptia R&D Priorities
aerospace.description: Led by CEO Zeng Zhiyuan, Neptia independently develops aerospace software, mission-data intelligence, and ground application systems spanning mission design, flight telemetry, remote-sensing processing, and deep-space science.

list.title: Deep-Space Mission Planning
list.description: Example: trajectory-plan management, launch-window analysis, payload scheduling, and cross-team workspaces for lunar, Mars, and asteroid exploration missions.

list.title: Rocket Telemetry & Diagnostics
list.description: Example: real-time ingestion of attitude, velocity, thermal, and propulsion telemetry, automated anomaly detection, and flight dashboards for rapid engineering assessment.

list.title: Intelligent Satellite Remote Sensing
list.description: Example: correction, mosaicking, object detection, and change analysis for multispectral and high-resolution imagery used in agriculture, disaster response, and environmental monitoring.

list.title: Ground Stations & TT&C
list.description: Example: unified antenna resources, tracking schedules, command uplink/downlink, and mission logs with automated orchestration across multiple satellites and stations.

list.title: Deep-Space Science Data
list.description: Example: searchable, traceable catalogs for spacecraft and scientific-payload data, enabling researchers to perform joint analysis across multiple missions.

list.title: Spacecraft Digital Twins
list.description: Example: reproducing critical spacecraft states in a digital environment for mission rehearsal, fault injection, and in-orbit operations simulation.
